topic: Introduction to Special purpose oscilloscope (Digital storage oscilloscope and sampling CRO)
syllabus_extract: Introduction to Special purpose oscilloscope (Digital storage oscilloscope and sampling CRO)
specific_objectives: 20.3.1.1 Trainee will be able to explain the construction and operation of DMM & CRO.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of DSO and Sampling CRO block diagrams; Safety: High voltage precautions; Supervision: Instructor monitors connections.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of a standard CRO?
Define the term 'sampling' in the context of signal acquisition.
List two limitations of an analog CRO regarding signal storage.

development.content:
Digital Storage Oscilloscope (DSO) Architecture
Analog-to-Digital Conversion Process
Memory Depth and Bandwidth Specifications
Waveform Capture and Triggering Mechanisms
Display Resolution and Update Rates

topics: Sample Rate Requirements for High Frequency
development.content:
Sampling Oscilloscope Principles
Real-Time vs Equivalent Sampling
Nyquist Theorem and Aliasing Effects
Sample Rate Requirements for High Frequency
Reconstruction of Continuous Waveforms

topics: Application Scenarios for Special Purpose Units
development.content:
Comparison: DSO vs Sampling CRO
Application Scenarios for Special Purpose Units
Advantages of Digital Storage Technology
Limitations of Sampling Techniques
Selection Criteria for Aircraft Maintenance

summary_questions: Explain how a DSO converts an analog input signal into a digital display.
Differentiate between real-time sampling and equivalent sampling methods.
Describe a scenario where a sampling CRO is preferred over a real-time DSO.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note comparing the architecture of a standard CRO with a Digital Storage Oscilloscope, highlighting the role of the ADC in the latter, to be discussed in LP 11 regarding Glass Cockpit architecture.

pft_rows.syllabus: Concept of Glass cockpit and architecture, Ring Laser Gyros. Practical demonstration of Gyro properties like rigidity and precision.
